regStepEyebrow.desc: Eyebrow label showing the current registration step out of 4

regStepEyebrowSuccess.desc: Eyebrow label on the registration success page

regEmailTitle.desc: Title of the email entry page (step 1 of registration)

regEmailHeading.desc: Heading next to the logo on the email entry page

regEmailIntro.fr: Nous vous envoyons un code de vérification à 6 chiffres. Votre email n'est pas lié à votre token et reste privé.
regEmailIntro.en: We will send you a 6-digit verification code. Your email is not linked to your token and remains private.
regEmailIntro.desc: Introductory text on the email entry page

regEmailFieldLabel.desc: Label of the email text field

regEmailInvalid.desc: Validation error when the email format is invalid

regSendingCode.desc: Button label while the email OTP is being sent

regReceiveCode.desc: Button to request the email verification code

regEmailPrivacyNote.fr: Aucun nom, prénom ou adresse précise ne sera stocké. Seuls votre sexe, tranche d'âge et code postal sont encodés (chiffrés) dans votre token anonyme.
regEmailPrivacyNote.en: No first name, last name or exact address will be stored. Only your sex, age range and postal code are encoded (encrypted) in your anonymous token.
regEmailPrivacyNote.desc: Privacy note at the bottom of the email entry page

regEmailOtpTitle.desc: Title of the email OTP verification page

regCodeSentTo.desc: Label above the email address the OTP was sent to

regVerifying.desc: Button label while an OTP code is being verified

regResendCode.desc: Button to resend the email verification code

regPhoneTitle.desc: Title of the phone entry page (step 2 of registration)

regPhoneIntro.fr: Un code SMS à 6 chiffres sera envoyé pour vérifier votre numéro. Aucun lien entre votre numéro et votre token.
regPhoneIntro.en: A 6-digit SMS code will be sent to verify your number. Your number is never linked to your token.
regPhoneIntro.desc: Introductory text on the phone entry page

regPhoneFieldHint.desc: Hint of the phone number text field

regSendingSms.desc: Button label while the SMS OTP is being sent

regReceiveSms.desc: Button to request the SMS verification code

regPhoneOtpTitle.desc: Title of the phone OTP verification page

regSmsSentTo.desc: Label above the phone number the SMS OTP was sent to

regResendSms.desc: Button to resend the SMS verification code

regDemoTitle.desc: Title of the demographics page (step 3 of registration)

regDemoIntro.fr: Ces informations seront chiffrées dans votre token. Aucune valeur exacte n'est stockée (ni âge précis, ni adresse précise).
regDemoIntro.en: This information will be encrypted in your token. No exact value is stored (neither your precise age nor your precise address).
regDemoIntro.desc: Introductory text on the demographics page

regSectionSex.desc: Section label (uppercase) for the sex selection

regSectionAgeBucket.desc: Section label (uppercase) for the age range selection

regSectionCountryPostal.desc: Section label (uppercase) for the country and postal code inputs

regPostalCodeHint.desc: Hint of the postal code text field

regGeneratingToken.desc: Button label while the anonymous token is being generated

regGenerateMyToken.desc: Button to submit demographics and generate the anonymous token

regSuccessTitle.desc: Title of the registration success page

regSuccessTokenSaved.fr: Votre token anonyme a été généré et sauvegardé sur cet appareil.
regSuccessTokenSaved.en: Your anonymous token has been generated and saved on this device.
regSuccessTokenSaved.desc: Confirmation message on the success page

regSuccessTokenDetails.fr: Il ne contient ni votre email, ni votre numéro de téléphone, ni votre nom. Uniquement votre sexe, votre tranche d'âge et votre zone géographique (chiffrés). Vous pouvez maintenant commencer votre évaluation cognitive.
regSuccessTokenDetails.en: It contains neither your email, nor your phone number, nor your name. Only your sex, age range and geographic area (encrypted). You can now start your cognitive assessment.
regSuccessTokenDetails.desc: Details about the token content on the success page

regImportantLabel.desc: Uppercase warning label on the success page

regSuccessWarning.fr: Ne désinstallez pas l'application sans avoir terminé votre évaluation : votre token est uniquement stocké sur cet appareil. Si vous le perdez, vous ne pourrez plus créer de nouveau compte avec le même email ou téléphone.
regSuccessWarning.en: Do not uninstall the app before completing your assessment: your token is only stored on this device. If you lose it, you will not be able to create a new account with the same email or phone number.
regSuccessWarning.desc: Warning about token being stored only on the device

regEmailAlreadyRegistered.fr: Cet email a déjà un compte. Si c'est le vôtre, vous avez déjà un token.
regEmailAlreadyRegistered.en: This email already has an account. If it is yours, you already have a token.
regEmailAlreadyRegistered.desc: Error when the email is already linked to an account

regEmailUnavailable.desc: Generic error when the email cannot be used

regOtpIncorrectOrExpired.desc: Error when an OTP code (email or SMS) is wrong or expired

regPhoneAlreadyRegistered.fr: Ce numéro a déjà un compte.
regPhoneAlreadyRegistered.en: This number already has an account.
regPhoneAlreadyRegistered.desc: Error when the phone number is already linked to an account

regPhoneUnavailable.desc: Generic error when the phone number cannot be used

regEmailAlreadyHasToken.fr: Cet email a déjà un token.
regEmailAlreadyHasToken.en: This email already has a token.
regEmailAlreadyHasToken.desc: Error at token generation when the email already has a token

regPhoneAlreadyHasToken.fr: Ce numéro a déjà un token.
regPhoneAlreadyHasToken.en: This number already has a token.
regPhoneAlreadyHasToken.desc: Error at token generation when the phone already has a token

regPostalNotFound.fr: Code postal introuvable. Vérifiez le pays et le code.
regPostalNotFound.en: Postal code not found. Check the country and the code.
regPostalNotFound.desc: Error when the submitted postal code is unknown

regNoInternet.desc: Error when the network is unreachable
